'''2007 US East Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 7–8 July 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2007 US East Nationals Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2007 US East Nationals Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 7–8 July 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
